rules.measured: 2026-09-17, pit2-p03-g17 + pit2-p03-g09, MI355X/gfx950 ionic, ordinary v2, EP16, H7168/K8, experts/rank16, QP2, MORI_DISABLE_IONIC_CCQE=1, live tokens=capacity=64. Quick sweep and three independent 7-rep/100-round head-to-heads, then three plain-table ABA groups PER dispatch dtype (100 rounds, warmup20, drop1). avg_latency_us is the mean of three BF16->BF16 candidate benches, with shipped Dispatch64/32/8 and the existing small-capacity LF kernel. Evidence: json_tuning_1b3e7dba/candidate_aba_c_k8_t64_{bf16,fp8}.json. Bandwidth fields follow the existing JSON convention: recorded rank0 token bytes / mean phase latency (LL applies its token expansion factor). Actual per-rank/per-round bandwidth means are recorded separately in the archived benchmark report and ABA evidence.
rules.note: Exact experts_per_rank=16 override; the same BF16 Combine row serves BF16 and FP8 dispatch. Versus original Combine96/64/8, BF16 C107.93->106.57us, pair225.23->223.53us (-0.75%); FP8 C108.72->107.27us, pair199.10->196.77us (-1.17%). All three ordinary ABA groups improved for each dtype; this is a small mean improvement. Original wildcard remains for other expert counts. Lookup uses live-token ceiling, not declared capacity; different capacity/QP/CQ performance is unmeasured.

rules.note: Exact experts_per_rank=16 override shared by BF16 and FP8 dispatch; original wildcard retained. BF16 C177.58->171.97us, pair345.32->339.40us (-1.71%); three ABA pair differences -6.40/-6.15/-5.20us. FP8 full means C185.68->174.53us, pair304.72->292.70us (-3.94%), with spikes retained; per-group pair differences -22.30/-10.10/-3.65us.
